description: This is a Spring Security configuration class ('SecurityConfig') that sets up basic security policies for a notes backend application. Currently, it permits all requests but defines a PasswordEncoder bean and a SecurityFilterChain bean that configures CSRF, headers, session management, and request authorization rules.

classes.name: SecurityConfig
classes.description: Configuration class that sets up security settings for the web application.

methods.name: passwordEncoder
methods.description: Creates and provides a PasswordEncoder bean using BCryptPasswordEncoder.

methods.name: filterChain
methods.description: Defines security filter chain settings, including CSRF disabling, headers configuration, session management, and request authorization rules.
